chunks: Sama‘ah narrated from him, peace be upon him, that he said:
"The salat (prayer) of the Day of Jumu‘ah with the Imam is two rak‘ahs; so whoever prays it alone, then it is four rak‘ahs."

key_terms.أَرْبَعُ رَكَعَاتٍ: four rak‘ahs, the prescribed number when prayed alone
key_terms.الْإِمَامِ: the Imam who leads the Jumu‘ah prayer
key_terms.رَكْعَتَانِ: two rak‘ahs, the prescribed number in congregation
key_terms.صَلَاةُ: salat (prayer), the ritual prayer being discussed
key_terms.وَحْدَهُ: alone, meaning individually and not with the Imam

ai.seo_question: How many rak‘ahs is the Friday salat (prayer) with the Imam and when prayed alone?
ai.summary: This hadith states the legal distinction between the Friday salat (prayer) performed with the Imam and when performed individually. With the Imam it is two rak‘ahs, while one who prays alone performs four rak‘ahs, indicating a jurisprudential ruling tied to congregational Jumu‘ah.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.1232 - Sama’a narrated from Imam (as) who said:
"The Jumu’ah prayer with the Imam consists of two rak'ahs, but whoever prays it alone, it is four rak'ahs."
